AGENDA
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
  NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  AUGUST 4, 2020
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDER N-25-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC AND
VIDEOCONFERENCED. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO:
publiccomments@norwalkca.gov CALL (571) 317-3122; ACCESS CODE: 156-198-269 DURING THE MEETING
TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM OR UNDER ORAL COMMUNICATIONS. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON
FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-
hall/meeting-agendas-393.

  REGULAR MEETING
  VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE
  6:00 P.M.

  Jennifer Perez, Chair
  Tony Ayala, Vice Chair
  Rick Ramirez, Board Member
  Margarita L. Rios, Board Member
  Ana Valencia, Board Member

  Public Comment: See above.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other
  services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the
  agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior
  to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to
  provide participation in the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Agency regarding any item on this agenda after it has been posted
  will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk’s Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard during regular
  business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday; telephone (562) 929-5720.
  You may also contact the City Clerk via e-mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.
 CALL TO ORDER  Chair Perez

ROLL CALL  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  Secretary

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll
call vote. Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by the
Agency.

1. MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends the Agency approve the minutes of the regular meeting
  of May 5, 2020.  1305-03

2. WARRANTS - Staff recommends the Agency approve the warrant register for the periods April 29,
  2020 – May 27, 2020, in the total amount of $1,513.31 and May 28, 2020 – June 30, 2020, in the
  total amount of $166,325.81.  1310-01

EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on
the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated this 31st day of July 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
Secretary

  1305-03

  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  NORWALK, CALIFORNIA
  MAY 5, 2020

Chair Perez called the regular meeting to order at 6:10 p.m. via teleconference pursuant
to the Governor’s Executive Orders N-20-20 and N-35-20. Responding to roll call were
Board Members Ramirez, Rios, and Valencia, Vice Chair Ayala, and Chair Perez. Also
present were Jesus M. Gomez, Executive Director; Arnold M. Alvarez-Glasman, Agency
Counsel; and Theresa Devoy, Secretary.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one
motion and roll call vote. Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and
considered separately by the Agency. Board Member Ramirez moved and Vice Chair
Ayala seconded to approve the consent calendar as recommended. MOTION CARRIED
BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Board Members Ramirez, Rios, and Valencia, Vice Chair Ayala and
  Chair Perez
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

MEETING MINUTES

The Agency approved the minutes of the regular meeting of February 4, 2020.  1305-03

WARRANTS

The Agency approved the warrant registers for the periods of March 1 – March 31, 2020,
in the total amount of $109,875 and April 1 – April 28, 2020, in the total amount of
$1,513.31.  1310-01

RESOLUTION NO. SA 20-21 – FASCIMILE SIGNATURES

The Agency adopted Resolution No. SA 20-01, A RESOLUTION OF THE SUCCESSOR
AGENCY TO THE NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY AUTHORIZING AND
DIRECTING CERTAIN BANKS TO HONOR ALL CHECKS, DRAFTS, AND WARRANTS
WHEN BEARING CERTAIN SIGNATURES AND FACSIMILE SIGNATURES OF
AGENCY OFFICIALS AND RESCINDING ALL CONFLICTING RESOLUTIONS.  602

  310
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment Agency
May 5, 2020

EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT

None.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

There were no persons wishing to address the Agency.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business to come before the Agency, the meeting was adjourned
at 6:12 p.m.

  ___________________________
  THERESA DEVOY, CMC
  SECRETARY
ATTEST:

____________________________
JENNIFER PEREZ
CHAIR
